name: Current Market Snapshot
description: No shock applied. The base curve is the latest data snapshot.
macro_interpretation: The reference state: today's curve, real yields, and breakevens.

name: Parallel +50 bps
description: All major curve points rise by 50 bps.
macro_interpretation: Tests baseline duration sensitivity under a uniform rate increase.
split_basis: per-tenor beta of daily real vs nominal yield changes, 2023-06-12 to 2026-06-11; 2Y borrows the 5Y beta

name: Parallel +100 bps
description: All major curve points rise by 100 bps.
macro_interpretation: A larger uniform shock that exposes convexity and approximation error.
split_basis: per-tenor beta of daily real vs nominal yield changes, 2023-06-12 to 2026-06-11; 2Y borrows the 5Y beta

name: Bear Steepener
description: Long-end yields rise more than front-end yields.
macro_interpretation: Punishes 10Y/30Y key-rate exposure; total duration alone understates the risk.
split_basis: per-tenor beta of daily real vs nominal yield changes, 2023-06-12 to 2026-06-11; 2Y borrows the 5Y beta

name: Bull Flattener
description: Front-end yields fall more than long-end yields.
macro_interpretation: A rally led by policy-rate repricing; front-end exposure gains most.
split_basis: per-tenor beta of daily real vs nominal yield changes, 2023-06-12 to 2026-06-11; 2Y borrows the 5Y beta

name: Front-End Repricing
description: 2Y/5Y yields move materially as the policy path reprices.
macro_interpretation: Tests short/intermediate books; long-duration books are less affected.
split_basis: per-tenor beta of daily real vs nominal yield changes, 2023-06-12 to 2026-06-11; 2Y borrows the 5Y beta

name: Long-End Term Premium Shock
description: 10Y/30Y yields rise disproportionately as term premium rebuilds.
macro_interpretation: Concentrated long-end losses with visible convexity effects.
split_basis: per-tenor beta of daily real vs nominal yield changes, 2023-06-12 to 2026-06-11; 2Y borrows the 5Y beta

name: Real-Rate Shock
description: Real yields rise across the curve; breakevens are stable.
macro_interpretation: Both nominal Treasuries and TIPS-style exposure lose; TIPS do not hedge real-rate repricing.

name: Breakeven Inflation Shock
description: Inflation compensation widens; real yields are stable.
macro_interpretation: Nominal Treasuries lose; TIPS-style exposure is insulated, the inflation-hedge case.

name: 2022 Inflation Replay
description: Measured Treasury curve shift over 2021-12-31 to 2022-12-30.
macro_interpretation: The 2022 episode: an inflation regime where real-yield repricing drove historic Treasury losses and broke the stock-bond hedge.
split_basis: measured DFII changes over the same window; 2Y borrows the 5Y change
